topic: Behind the Scenes of Building a Website

slides.text: What building a website actually looks like behind the scenes
slides.subtext: No client name. Just the real process.

slides.text: It starts with a blank screen and a list of requirements
slides.subtext: No template. No shortcuts. Every project from zero.

slides.text: We plan the structure before writing a single line of code
slides.subtext: Pages, components, data flow — all mapped out first.

slides.text: Then comes the code — components, logic, layout, one by one
slides.subtext: This part takes the longest. And it should.

slides.text: We test on every device. Mobile first. Then tablet. Then desktop.
slides.subtext: If it breaks on a phone, it does not ship.

slides.text: Performance check — we do not launch until it loads in under 3 seconds
slides.subtext: Speed is not optional. It is the product.

slides.text: This is what you are paying for when you hire a real dev team

caption:
What building a website actually looks like behind the scenes

It starts with a blank screen and a list of requirements. No template. No shortcuts.

We plan the structure before writing a single line of code.

Then comes the code — components, logic, layout, one by one.

We test on every device. Mobile first. Then tablet. Then desktop.

Performance check — we do not launch until it loads in under 3 seconds.

This is what you are paying for when you hire a real dev team.
